name: The R Apartments Mezzanine

facts.text: Mezzanine apartments for up to 3 guests: a king bed on the mezzanine level and a sofa bed in the living room.
A balcony with outdoor seating above the garden, a shared pool and a private entrance.
Air conditioning, TV, WiFi, a washer, a safe box and a hair dryer; linens and towels are provided.
Full kitchen with stove, microwave, toaster, coffee maker, blender, kettle and a refrigerator with freezer.
Free parking on the premises. Pererenan Beach is about 5 minutes on foot.
